environment.description: Celery worker deployed on EKS cluster (namespace: analytics-prod). Worker pods run with default service account. Redis broker accessible on internal network at redis.analytics.svc.cluster.local:6379 without AUTH. No network policies applied to the analytics-prod namespace. TASK_SIGNING_KEY environment variable is not set (signature validation disabled). Worker accepts tasks from any producer that can reach the Redis broker. Instance metadata service (IMDS) accessible at 169.254.169.254 with IMDSv1 enabled on the underlying EC2 nodes.
